metadata.title: On the Morse index of some Riemannian homogeneous fibrations
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we use the technique developed by the first named author in arXiv:2610.07815 to compute the Morse-index of some Riemannian homogeneous fibrations. For the quaternionic (resp. octonionic) Hopf fibration, we compute the index and nullity, where the metric on the $\mathbb{S}^7$ (resp. $\mathbb{S}^{15}$) is the quaternionic (resp. octonionic) Hopf--Berger metric. In particular, for the round metric on the domain, the Morse-index is $45$ (resp. $153$). We also give a spectral formula for the Aloff--Wallach projections. In particular, we obtain that the Konishi $\mathbb{R} P^3$-fibration $N_{1,1}\to\mathbb{C} P^2$ is stable throughout the two-parameter metric family, while the unit tangent sphere bundle $T^1(\mathbb{C} P^2)\to \mathbb{C} P^2$ is stable under some conditions on the metric. We also compute the index and nullity of the Clifford hypersurface in the fiber-squashing range of the quaternionic Berger family. Finally, for the identity map on the quaternionic Hopf--Berger spheres, we determine its Morse--index by an explicit sequence of transition parameters.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Hopf–Berger 纤维压缩下的 Jacobi 谱与指标跃迁
analysis.workSummary: 写 g_t=g_H+t g_V，0<t≤1，g_H、g_V 来自单位圆球，固定使投影为黎曼下沉的目标圆度量。四元数 Hopf S⁷→S⁴ 的指标随 t 下降依次为 45、13、5，阈值 3/4、3/8，等号处取较低指标。八元数 Hopf S¹⁵→S⁸ 对应为 153、25、9，阈值 7/16、7/20。四元数情形通常零度 10，在 t=1、3/4、3/8 为 25、42、18。八元数情形通常零度 36，在 t=1、7/16、7/20 为 120、164、52。
techniques: 齐性调和映射的 Jacobi 算子
Casimir 算子与 Peter–Weyl 分解
表示分支、张量积与固定子空间
恒等映射的 Schur 补与特征值过零
analysis.breakthrough: 由有限个可非正的谱块计算指数和零度。Konishi 投影全参数稳定且零度 16，单位切球丛投影恰在 ε²≥δ² 时稳定。Clifford 超曲面面积指标随 t 下降由 9 跃至 1，阈值 t=1/3。四元数 Berger 球恒等映射的调和映射指标在 t→0 时反而趋于无穷，Jensen 参数 t=1/5 时恒等映射与 Hopf 投影的指标分别为 13、5。
analysis.limitations: Hopf 指标分段限 0<t≤1，t 是纤维长度的平方倍率。圆球 Hopf 投影的指标超过已知通用下界，圆球到同一目标的非恒定调和映射最小指标仍开放。Clifford 结论是面积的法向变分指标，并与 Siffert 更一般结果一致。补读第2–3、5、8–9、12–13、15–16、19–23页的定理和谱块路线，未逐项核验全部分支系数与计算。
